A_FALSE_CLEAN_I_CAUGHT_IN_MY_OWN_FIRST_P: my first join keyed on `name`/`file`/`line`; the instrument's never_exercised entries key on `token` and `files`. Every lookup returned empty, so the register reported 167 of 167 EXERCISED and ZERO gaps. A clean answer from a broken join looks exactly like a clean answer from a clean system -- I re-checked because it was too clean, not because anything flagged it.

supersedes.scope: the verifier now JOINS CODE TO ROWS; the recorded POPULATION is removed.

THE_GAP_REVIEW_168_FOUND.what_v1_could_not_do: refuse an UNREGISTERED site. The AST enumerator saw a new `raise ...Refused` go 10 -> 11 and the register stayed at 167 with the verdict unmoved -- NOTHING JOINED CODE TO ROWS.
THE_GAP_REVIEW_168_FOUND.why_that_is_the_gap_that_matters: a list of guards is not a guard over the list. v1 could tell you a KNOWN site was undriven; it could not tell you a site existed that nobody had ever considered -- which is the only failure mode that grows silently as code lands.
THE_GAP_REVIEW_168_FOUND.v2_FIX: the verifier RE-RUNS the AST enumeration over the declared files AT VERIFY TIME and compares: GUARD_REGISTER_INCOMPLETE:<site> when an enumerated site has NO ROW, GUARD_REGISTER_STALE:<site> when a row names a site that no longer exists. Both name the site.
THE_GAP_REVIEW_168_FOUND.so_the_register_can_no_longer_go_quietly: it fails loudly the first time the code moves under it

the_exercise_instrument.ITS_DECLARED_LIMIT: TEXTUAL PREDICATE. A cell that drives a refusal WITHOUT NAMING it reads as never-exercised, so THE ERROR INFLATES RATHER THAN DEFLATES. This is a FLOOR on what has been SEEN to be driven, never an exact defect count.

POPULATION_IS_DERIVED_NEVER_RECORDED: v1 recorded POPULATION 217. IT WAS STALE BY MEASUREMENT THE SAME DAY -- the count moved while the field did not. v2 records NO population; the verifier returns POPULATION_derived_now from the enumeration it just ran. A count that is written down is a claim about a moment; a count that is derived is a measurement.
ROWS_REGENERATED_AT_THE_CURRENT_REFS: v1's rows were enumerated before the valuation pin moved to c853e2d, so re-enumerating at the current ref found 53 sites with no row -- the completeness join firing on its FIRST run, against the register that created it. The rows are regenerated at BUILD 7ed5a9015f75 and VALUATION origin/de-freeze-chain-v2.
